library(haven)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(labelled)
library(readr)

# Load all files from data/input/
# Wave 1 (Age 14) - Young Person
wave1 <- read_delim("data/input/wave_one_lsype_young_person_2020.tab", delim = "\t", show_col_types = FALSE)

# Wave 2 (Age 15) - Family Background
wave2 <- read_delim("data/input/wave_two_lsype_family_background_2020.tab", delim = "\t", show_col_types = FALSE)

# Wave 3 (Age 16) - Family Background
wave3 <- read_delim("data/input/wave_three_lsype_family_background_2020.tab", delim = "\t", show_col_types = FALSE)

# Wave 4 (Age 17) - Young Person
wave4 <- read_delim("data/input/wave_four_lsype_young_person_2020.tab", delim = "\t", show_col_types = FALSE)

# Wave 9 (Age 32) - Derived Variables
wave9 <- read_delim("data/input/ns9_2022_derived_variables.tab", delim = "\t", show_col_types = FALSE)

# Check loaded data
cat("Wave 1 dimensions:", dim(wave1), "\n")
cat("Wave 2 dimensions:", dim(wave2), "\n")
cat("Wave 3 dimensions:", dim(wave3), "\n")
cat("Wave 4 dimensions:", dim(wave4), "\n")
cat("Wave 9 dimensions:", dim(wave9), "\n")

# Inspect IMDRSCORE in wave2
cat("\nWave 2 IMDRSCORE stats:\n")
print(summary(wave2$IMDRSCORE))
cat("Unique values (first 20):", head(sort(unique(wave2$IMDRSCORE)), 20), "\n")

# Inspect IMDRSCORE in wave3
cat("\nWave 3 IMDRSCORE stats:\n")
print(summary(wave3$IMDRSCORE))

# Inspect W9DIMDD in wave9
cat("\nWave 9 W9DIMDD stats:\n")
print(summary(wave9$W9DIMDD))

# Merge all datasets
merged <- wave1 %>%
  full_join(wave2, by = "NSID") %>%
  full_join(wave3, by = "NSID") %>%
  full_join(wave4, by = "NSID") %>%
  full_join(wave9, by = "NSID")

cat("\nMerged data dimensions:", dim(merged), "\n")

# Derive imd15 from wave2 IMDRSCORE
# IMDRSCORE is continuous (scale), handle missing values
# -94 = Insufficient Information -> -8
# Other negative values (-999 to -95, -93 to -1) -> -2 (schedule not applicable / info lost)
merged <- merged %>%
  mutate(
    imd15_raw = IMDRSCORE,
    imd15 = case_when(
      IMDRSCORE == -94 ~ -8,
      IMDRSCORE < 0 ~ -2,
      TRUE ~ IMDRSCORE
    )
  )

# Derive imd16 from wave3 IMDRSCORE
merged <- merged %>%
  mutate(
    imd16_raw = IMDRSCORE,
    imd16 = case_when(
      IMDRSCORE == -94 ~ -8,
      IMDRSCORE < 0 ~ -2,
      TRUE ~ IMDRSCORE
    )
  )

# Derive imd32 from wave9 W9DIMDD
# W9DIMDD is a decile (1-10) with -8 = Insufficient information
merged <- merged %>%
  mutate(
    imd32_raw = W9DIMDD,
    imd32 = case_when(
      W9DIMDD == -8 ~ -8,
      TRUE ~ W9DIMDD
    )
  )

# Check derived variables
cat("\nimd15 summary:", summary(merged$imd15), "\n")
cat("\nimd16 summary:", summary(merged$imd16), "\n")
cat("\nimd32 summary:", summary(merged$imd32), "\n")

# Create final output with only NSID and derived variables
# imd15 and imd16 are continuous (IMD scores) - keep as numeric
# imd32 is a decile (factor with labels)

final_output <- merged %>%
  select(NSID, imd15, imd16, imd32)

# Write output
cat("\nWriting output...")
write_csv(final_output, "data/output/cleaned_data.csv")
cat("Done!\n")

# Verify output
cat("Output dimensions:", dim(final_output), "\n")
cat("Output columns:", names(final_output), "\n")
cat("\nFirst 10 rows:\n")
print(head(final_output, 10))

4. **Decide the Output Structure**
   - The two primary structures are:
     a. **One consolidated variable** — a single value per person across all waves. Used for stable or time-invariant constructs such as sex, ethnicity, or language.
     b. **Separate wave-specific variables** — one variable per person per wave, named with an age suffix. Use for time-varying constructs such as economic activity, partnership status, or income.
   - Base this decision on the construct, metadata labels, available waves, and additional requirements.
   - Where the same construct applies to multiple subjects (e.g., mother and father), create parallel sets of variables — one per subject — following the same a/b structure.
